title: Let’s repeat what we learned
intro: The conditions of the religion, Iman, Islam, Al-Ikhlas and Salah – let’s repeat!

learn.html: Let’s repeat! Say the missing words with your muallim:

items: Din means ______, and shart means ______. There are ____ conditions of the religion: six of ______, five of ______, four of ______, three of tayammum, ______ of ghusl and twelve of ______.
Ihsan is the highest awareness of Allah – as if we ______ Him, because even if we don’t see Him, ______.
The pillars of Iman are ____ basic truths of faith. The first is: Aamantu ______ – I believe in Allah.
Surah Al-Ikhlas is worth ______ of the Qur’an. Recite Al-Ikhlas!
Salah is the ______ main duty of a Muslim. The Prophet (SAW) said: “Know that your best deed is ______.”
There are ______ conditions of Salah: six ______ Salah and six ______ Salah.

questions.q: How many conditions of the religion are there?

options: Worshipping Allah as if we see Him
